higher_dimensions.name: Higher Dimensions: Beyond 3D
higher_dimensions.truth: We are 3D creatures projecting 4D shadows. The tesseract rotates through dimensions we cannot directly perceive.
higher_dimensions.qfep_connection: Higher-dimensional geometry extends F (order) into spaces we cannot inhabit. Pure structure, revealed through projectionâ€”the Platonic forms casting shadows into our world.
higher_dimensions.description: Explore geometry beyond three dimensions. Tesseracts, penteracts, 16-cellsâ€”polytopes that exist in 4D and 5D space, visualized through projection into 3D. Walk through the nets, see rotations through the fourth dimension.
learning_objectives: Projection: how higher-D casts shadows into lower-D

artifact_groups.rationale: Tesseract tunnel: walk through a 4D hypercube projected into 3D. The error tunnel — where dimensional projection breaks, you feel the fourth dimension.
16-cell: the 4D analog of the octahedron, unfolded as a walkable net. Eight tetrahedral cells projected into space you can inhabit.
Tesseract net space: the eight cubes of a hypercube unfolded into 3D. Walk through Dalí's Corpus Hypercubus — the cross-shaped net of the fourth dimension.
Tessellating portals: dimensional boundaries you can step through. Synthesis of projection, nets, and higher-dimensional topology as navigable architecture.
